title: Indian safari
subtitle: A wedding in Bengaluru. A little adventure after.
notice: Waiting on Max: what time does the final event on 26 November finish, and is anything planned for the 27th? That decides when we can leave for Hampi.

events.title: First arrivals in Bengaluru
events.notes: Brodie’s shared itinerary arrives on the 19th. Confirm everyone else’s local arrival date before setting the Airbnb check-in; an 18 November departure can arrive on the 19th.

events.title: Bryce joins the crew
events.notes: Direct Qantas flight from Sydney. Airport transfer and meeting point still to arrange.

events.title: Settle in
events.notes: Time to settle in and sort outfits. Max’s guidance was to bring a normal suit and arrange a traditional outfit locally; confirm which outfit goes with each event.

events.title: Wedding celebrations
events.notes: Exact address, arrival time and group transport still to be confirmed with Max.

events.title: A day in the city
events.notes: No wedding activity confirmed for today. Leave room for plans from the wedding group.

events.title: The first main event
events.notes: Event programme, dress code and transport to be confirmed.

events.title: Catch our breath
events.notes: A flexible day between the two main events. Check for any additional wedding activities.

events.title: The final main event
events.notes: Brodie says this is the last event. Max has been asked to confirm the finish time and whether anything follows on the 27th. Do not book the Hampi departure around an assumed finish.

events.title: Possible overnight train to Hampi
events.notes: Hampi Express 16592, First AC preferred. Only workable if the wedding finishes early enough for luggage collection, traffic and station arrival. If not, investigate a 27 November daytime departure instead; nothing is booked.

events.title: Hampi, day one
events.notes: Transfer from Hosapete, drop bags and explore the ruins. One hotel night proposed: check in 27 November, check out 28 November. Hotel, travellers and local transport still to choose.

events.title: Hampi, day two
events.notes: A second day exploring, then Hampi Express 16591 overnight to Bengaluru. Arrange luggage storage after hotel checkout and a station transfer. First AC availability and cabin allocation are unconfirmed.

events.title: Back to Bengaluru, then home
events.notes: Bryce’s Qantas return departs BLR at 17:30. The proposed train arrives at KSR Bengaluru, not the airport. Allow for train delays, the airport transfer and airline check-in; this is a separate, unprotected connection. The rest of the group’s onward plans are TBC.

events.title: Touch down in Sydney
events.notes: Bryce arrives home on Monday morning, the day after leaving India.

stay.name: Urban Escape · 4BHK Spacez Villa with Patio
stay.lead: Suggested booking leads: Brodie + Moody — confirm together
stay.notes: Bryce joins on the 20th. Set check-in from the earliest confirmed arrival. Keep checkout on the 27th as the working plan until the final wedding finish and Hampi departure are settled. Leaving on the 26th would still need somewhere to change and store bags that day.
checks: Confirm arrival dates, total guests and separate beds/rooms before booking.
Agree the exact checkout date and who is continuing to Hampi.
Check the actual route to Leela Palace and transport to Dollars Colony.
Review cancellation terms and the listing’s stated absence of smoke and carbon-monoxide alarms.

tasks.title: Confirm the wedding finish
tasks.detail: Final event end time on the 26th, and any activities on the 27th. Asked in Indian safari on 25 October; awaiting reply.

tasks.title: Set the Airbnb dates and rooms
tasks.detail: Suggested leads, pending agreement. Confirm earliest arrival, checkout, headcount and room preferences, then share the chosen stay.

tasks.title: Who’s in for Hampi?
tasks.detail: Confirm names and onward plans. Three travellers in the earlier train discussion is a working assumption, not a confirmed headcount.

tasks.title: Choose the outbound journey
tasks.detail: Use 26 November overnight only if it fits the wedding. Otherwise check a 27 November daytime option before fixing the hotel dates.

tasks.title: Check trains, hotel and transfers
tasks.detail: Check date-specific First AC tickets and current timetable, choose a hotel and arrange station transfers. A private cabin together is a preference, not a guarantee.

tasks.title: Wedding day logistics
tasks.detail: Start times, dress codes, exact Dollars Colony address and transport for 22, 24 and 26 November.
